name: IMU / motion sensor board
description: Accelerometer, gyroscope and magnetometer (IMU) with clean supplies, interrupt lines and mechanical mounting considerations.
electrical_characteristics: Mechanical coupling: mount near the board's stiff region, away from vibration sources
Magnetometer away from magnets and current-carrying traces
critical_electrical_constraints: IMU on a rigid area, orientation documented
Magnetometer keep-out from high-current traces and ferromagnetic parts
Decoupling at the IMU pins per datasheet
stackup_recommendations: 4 layers with a solid analog ground under the signal chain; 2 layers only for low-resolution sensing
placement_rules: Signal chain in a straight line: sensor -> amplifier -> filter -> ADC -> reference, each stage adjacent to the next
Reference and ADC decoupling at the pins; reference away from heat sources
Digital parts, radios and regulators on the far side of the board from the front end
routing_rules: Guard rings around high-impedance nodes driven by the buffered input potential
Differential sensor inputs routed as a matched pair
Single ground plane with partitioned placement rather than a split plane; no digital returns through the analog area
Short traces at ADC inputs; RC filter at the pin
copper_ground_requirements: Unbroken ground under the signal chain
No pour touching high-impedance input nodes (leakage); solder-mask relief considered for pA-level inputs
thermal_considerations: Thermocouple cold-junction sensor at the connector; avoid thermal gradients across precision resistors
emi_emc_considerations: RC/ferrite filtering at every input entering the board
Shield the front end from switching regulators; clock sources away from the ADC
protection_requirements: Input over-voltage clamps and series resistance sized for the amplifier's input current limits
verification_requirements: Noise budget and resolution target recorded; reference and ADC specs from datasheets
Guard and ground partition checked in placement review
Netlist read-back; ERC for floating inputs
manufacturing_constraints: Precision resistors as 0.1 % thin-film where the budget needs it; no HASL on fine-pitch ADC packages
unsupported_conditions: IMU next to a vibrating motor driver or at a board edge that flexes
